name: Default-calendar permission observations (selected mailboxes)
description: Read the unique returned default calendar for selected mailbox GUIDs, preserving localised paths and original principals. No effective delegate/access claim.

parameters.name: MailboxGuids
parameters.label: Exchange mailbox GUIDs
parameters.help: Choose 1–50 exact Exchange mailbox GUIDs, separated by commas. Names, SMTP addresses and Entra object IDs are not substituted.

prerequisites: Approved installed ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later and recipient read access. Role names and module output remain live-unverified; the toolkit installs nothing.
limitations: Experimental read-only Run, off by default. Exact selected mailbox GUIDs, installed supported module/runtime, verified tenant/account and exact review required.
At most50targets,5,000 combined raw folder/ACL rows including target diagnostics,100calls,100values per list,300seconds and32MiB output; partial reads never become deployment before-evidence.

Only a unique returned FolderType Calendar and validated returned folder ID/path admits an ACL. No English-name guess, first-folder selection, principal lookup or effective-access inference. Default/Anonymous retain their typed source namespace.
Actual module properties, role access and Microsoft behaviour remain live-unverified; missing/null values and ambiguous discovery are explicit. No changes, module installation or automatic retry.
